[/size][/b][/center][b][center][size=6]Documentation:[/size][/center][/b]
1 Heart Event:
[i](In Town; from 11:30am to 3:00pm; sunny weather)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]The Misunderstanding:[/b]
Finding a hair tie you suspect it belongs to Haley and try to give it to her... (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

2 Heart Event:
[i](At Bus Stop; from 2:00pm to 5:00pm; sunny weather; event 1 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Unexpected Help:[/b]
Haley comes back from a shopping trip and you can help her with her shopping bags...(play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

3 Heart Event:
[i](In Forest; from 11:00am to 4:00pm; sunny weather; not in winter; event 2 had to be seen)
(will [b][color=#ea9999]not[/color][/b] trigger around the time of the Temporary Summer Events, Summer 16th-21st)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]A New View:[/b]
Haley is at her usual photography spot but she feels stuck with no new motives, you can encourage her to find a new perspective...(play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

4 Heart Event:
[i](At Haley's home; while Haley is at home; event 3 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Vulnerable Failure:[/b]
Haley is crying at home because she didn't get a model job. she opens up to you about feeling like the failure of the family and that she thinks that her parents abandoned her and Emily...(play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

5 Heart Event:
[i](At Beach; from 6:00am to 10:30am; sunny weather; not in winter; event 4 had to be seen)
[b](Please don't skip the event while you're in the water... or the player model will be buggy) [/b][/i]
[SPOILER][b]Facing Fears:[/b]
On an early morning on the Beach you unexpectedly run into Haley in her bikini. She feels caught off guard. Not wanting to admit it at first she tells you that she is scared of swimming in the ocean but read about facing your fear on the internet. she tried to face her fear but was unable to. you can offer her to face her fear together...(play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

6 Heart Event:
[i](you'll get a mail from Haley)
(At Haley's home; while Haley is at home; letter had to be read; event 5 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Stylish Show:[/b]
Haley writes you a letter inviting you to her home. She wants to show you some off the new outfits she came up with. You can choose to support her which will make her very emotional because no one ever gave her the feeling that fashion is a valuable hobby...(play to find out more)
The Haley portraits and sprites were made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]Airyn[/url] 
The last outfit with the scarf (sprite and portrait) was heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] winter look for Haley[/SPOILER]

7 Heart Event:
[i](At the Beach; from 2:00pm to 10:00pm; rainy weather; event 6 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Outcast:[/b]
Haley is sad at the beach feeling like she is unable to be part of the town community even tho she wants to now...(play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

8 Heart Event:
[i]([b]ONLY[/b] If you supported Haley in the last event she will send you mail)
(At the Beach; from 1:00pm to 4:00pm; sunny weather; letter had to be read; event 7 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Beach Clean Up:[/b]
Haley organizes a beach cleanup event and asks for your assistance. She is very nervous about the event... Can you help her?(play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

9 Heart Event:
[i](At Haley's home; while Haley is at home; 1 free inventory spot needed; event 4 and 7 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Great News:[/b]
The Local Newspaper that Haley couldn't get the model job in is interested in her photography. what a cute moment to celebrate ;) <3 [/SPOILER]

10 Heart Event:
[i](a friend will send you mail inviting you to the beach at midnight)
[b](Please Set Game-"Zoom Level" to 100% before starting the event or else it wont work properly <3 also a new day starts after the event...)[/b]
(At the Beach; from 11:30pm to 0:30am; sunny weather; letter had to be read; event 9 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]How Far We've come:[/b]
Haley pours her heart out...(very cute, you should play it yourself)[/SPOILER]
